title: Palo Alto Networks in Talks to Buy AI Startup Clutch Security for $500 Million

tickers.name: Palo Alto Networks, Inc. Common Stock

summary:
The cybersecurity firm is pursuing a new acquisition to expand its security tools for autonomous software identities. Palo Alto Networks is in discussions to buy Clutch Security for $500 million to bolster its ability to control how artificial intelligence agents handle corporate data and passwords.

The deal would follow the company's previous $25 billion purchase of CyberArk, which primarily addressed the security of logins for human users. The acquisition of the AI security startup would shift focus toward the non-human identities used by automated agents.
